title: Hours From Minutes
description: Read an integer number of minutes m and print the equivalent hours with exactly one decimal place, using hours = m / 60. This is the transfer variant of 'Fahrenheit to Celsius': same underlying C1 skill (console-input conversion plus float division that must not truncate), different real-world calculation and divisor. Copying the temperature formula (F - 32) * 5 / 9 cannot produce these answers.
output_format: A single number: the hours equivalent with exactly one decimal place.
